name: The Glorious Cloak of Many Eyes

system.description:
The wearer projects his invisible self up to 30" away to see and hear what happens there, without taking part.

Charges: roll d100 when found. Rechargeable with the Thoroughly Useful Eye.

How many exist: said to be three. Never for sale, though one may sometimes be borrowed from a temple or the Imperium for a mission.
